name: Behind The Curtains
source: In this game, you will follow the lives of two characters: an ordinary-looking young man hiding a huge secret, and a police officer investigating a case in New York City. The story alternates between your struggle for survival and the police officer's investigation, where every choice can lead to shocking revelations or a tragic ending.
